articles.title: A Near-total Lunar Eclipse Will Turn the Moon Red This Month—and It’s the Last Chance to See One for Over 2 Years - Travel + Leisure
articles.description: The Americas will have a front-row seat to the deepest lunar eclipse until New Year’s Eve 2028.
articles.content:
After delivering a total solar eclipse and pristine dark skies for the Perseid meteor shower, August closes a packed stargazing month with a near-total lunar eclipse.
